newsitem.title: USA: Former Prudential employees interviewed - Journal.
newsitem.headline: Former Prudential employees interviewed - Journal.

text.p: Former Prudential Insurance employees have been interviewed by federal investigators about potential obstruction of justice connected to suits alleging sales fraud, The Wall Street Journal said Thursday.
The paper attributed the information to lawyers for several of those interviewed and other sources.
The interviews were held at least as recently as mid-May, the Journal said.
The story said it remains unclear whether the inquiry continued beyond preliminary stages.
The probe reportedly stems from the recent massive class-action suit accusing Prudential of misleading practices in life insurance sales, the story said.
Under a settlement, the paper said, Prudential agreed to pay policyholders at least $410 million.
